citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Selected Experience: A Preregistered Test of Reputation as a Data Filter Under Recursive Training (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7665358

isBasedOn.name: Selected Experience: A Preregistered Test of Reputation as a Data Filter Under Recursive Training

abstract: This paper preregisters, freezes, and runs a test of whether domain-scoped reliability weights, earned once against a key, improve a validity filter under recursive training. A replication of the published language-model protocol served as the gate for reading any outcome. The published collapse result did not reproduce under the frozen rule, so the Gaussian substrate is not read, its outcomes stay sealed, the fact-corpus substrate is blocked as well, and the paper reports no filter result.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: The gate is the paper's own precondition for reading any other substrate.
